people.imagined: The ferry deck at midday, mid-strait. He has just told a joke to a stranger who does not know he is the head of the sect. His laugh is carrying across the water, and he is fanning himself with a folded grey sail-cloth fan.
people.subject: The moment: on a ferry deck in bright wind he throws his head back in a huge laugh, a grey fan in one hand. Face (most important: the laugh and the salt in the beard): a brown, loose, rubbery face with deep laugh lines, a wide mouth open in laughter showing strong teeth, a short beard salted with white, small bright dark eyes squeezed shut with delight, a big nose peeling at the tip, a squint; about fifty. Hair: grey-black, wind-blown, tied loosely at the nape with a strip of grey sailcloth, a little loose around the face. Body: tall, loose-jointed, long arms, easy lounging stance, one hip against the rail. Clothing: a rumpled coat of sea-grey sailcloth, clean but unbuttoned, over a pale undyed tunic, a duckweed-green cord at the waist, bare brown forearms. Hands and objects: a folding fan of grey sailcloth on pale wooden ribs held open in the right hand; on the left forefinger a ring of carved bone. Background: grey-green sea and a ferry's rope rigging and sail, blurred, gulls. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, spray glitter. Expression: roaring, careless good humour. A faint teal-blue Water and pale wind hint round the fan. Palette: sailcloth grey, sea green, salt white.

people.imagined: On the tide hall's stone steps at dusk, with the great crab's shell on her back like a door. She stands looking at the moon coming up over the cliffs of an abbey she has not seen in years, quietly deciding not to say what she wants.
people.subject: The moment: on stone steps at dusk, a great round shell on her back like a door, she looks out to sea and the rising moon. Face: a thin, severe, finely lined face with high cheekbones, a long straight nose, deep-set dark eyes, a thin pale mouth that does not give anything away; about forty-five. Hair (a feature): black with broad white streaks from the temples, drawn into a severe knot at the nape with a bone pin. Body: thin, upright, an austere teacher's carriage, the heavy shell hardly bending her. Clothing: a clean robe of undyed sailcloth woven of pale sea-grass, cross collar, long narrow sleeves, a duckweed-green cord belt. Hands and objects: on her back a huge brown crab shell as big as a door, ridged and barnacle-spotted, held on by a leather strap across the chest; in her right hand a round bronze mirror turned toward the moon, its edge green. Sea-spray has dampened the hem of her robe, the barnacles on the shell glint with wet, and her white-streaked hair stirs in the cold wind. Background: a darkening sea, a pale rising moon, tidal rocks, blurred. Light: blue dusk from the left with moon-silver on the mirror. Expression: reserved, watchful, a faint ache. A faint pale silver-blue Water hint at the mirror. Palette: shell brown, dusk blue, silver.

people.imagined: At nightfall on the quay, carrying the ferry's stern lamp ashore in both hands like a funeral lantern. He is not smiling; he has not missed a crossing, and the lamp is lit.
people.subject: The moment: at nightfall on a stone quay he carries a lit lantern ashore in both hands, held low and reverent. Face: a square, silent, weathered face with a heavy jaw, a short flat nose, small dark steady eyes under heavy brows, a closed mouth; stubble; about forty-five. Hair: black going grey, cropped short under a knotted sail-cloth head scarf. Body: short, square, thick-set, a rooted stance. His shoulders are as wide as the stern post and he stands with feet planted apart, as if the deck were never going to move. Clothing: a tunic of undyed salt-white sailcloth, clean, with a glossy dark-amber oilskin jacket over it, a green duckweed cord belt; trousers rolled, wet boots. The oilskin is cut with a long skirt to the knee and is buttoned with three horn buttons, the lowest one missing; the sailcloth tunic beneath has a neat patch of paler cloth at the left elbow. Hands and objects: a heavy old stern lamp of bronze and horn with a steady yellow flame held in both hands, its light on his chin; a thick iron anchor hook hangs at his belt; tar blackens under the fingernails. Background: a dark quay, a moored ferry with a dim sail, a few harbour lights, blurred. Behind him a row of rope bollards, a coil of wet hawser and the single lit window of the ferry office glow faintly. Light: the lamp from below, warm, with cool blue dusk elsewhere. A band of cold blue sky still shows at the top of the frame. Expression: solemn, silent, devoted. A faint teal Water hint in the dark. Palette: amber, black, salt white.

people.imagined: A mangrove quay in the rain. She stands in her dead husband's oilskin cut down to fit, jaw set, looking at the sea where he went, her hand tight on the rail, the word lending in her mouth.
people.subject: The moment: at a rain-wet quay she stands with her fist on a rail, looking out to sea with a hard stare. Face (most important: the burnt-dark face): a tall woman's long face burned very dark by sun and wind, high cheekbones, a strong nose, narrow black eyes, thick straight brows drawn down, a wide, set mouth; a thin white scar on the chin; about forty-four. Hair: black, braided in two long plaits wrapped round the head, tied with tarred twine. Body: tall, broad-shouldered, strong-armed, a hard, upright stance. Clothing: a man's long dark-amber oilskin coat, cut down at the sleeves and hem to fit her, with a high collar, slick with rain, over undyed sailcloth, a duckweed cord belt. Hands and objects: the right fist gripping a wet rope rail; in the left a small stone seal on a cord wrapped round the fingers. Background: green mangrove roots, grey rain, a dark sea, blurred. Light: flat grey rain light from the upper left, a wet shine on the oilskin. A thin band of pale light along the horizon outlines her cheekbone and the wet shine of the oilskin collar. Expression: grim, vengeful, patient. A faint pale-teal Water hint in the rain. Palette: oilskin amber, rain grey, mangrove green.

people.imagined: The shipyard at dawn, shavings in the air. He stands over a half-built third hull and gently smooths a rib with the three-fingered left hand, saying quietly that the hulls were sound.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a half-built hull's rib at dawn, he smooths the wood with his left palm, three fingers only. Face (most important: sawdust in the eyebrows): a long, kind, stooped face, with grey eyebrows full of pale sawdust, deep-set pale eyes, a hooked nose, a thin grey beard, a patient mouth; about fifty-five. Hair: thin grey, a plain headcloth tied behind. A fine fall of sawdust dusts the hair at the temples and the shoulders of the tunic. Body: stooped, narrow, long arms like a cane raftsman's, a slow careful stance. Clothing: a clean tunic of undyed sailcloth with an apron of tarred canvas over it, a duckweed cord belt, sleeves rolled; wood shavings on the shoulders. Hands and objects: the left hand with only three fingers (thumb, forefinger, middle) lying on the dark ribs; the right holding a small wooden plane, a pale curl of agarwood falling from it; on the ground a coil of rope. Background: a great ship's skeleton of dark agarwood ribs, early morning haze, blurred. Light: low golden dawn from the upper left through floating dust. Slanting beams of dawn catch the drifting dust like threads of gold. Expression: humble, stubborn, patient. A faint green Wood hint at the shavings. Palette: agarwood brown, sawdust gold, pale blue.

people.imagined: The ferry office on the quay at noon. A traveller's fare lies in a heap of white shell coin; she taps one on her teeth, counting, her eyes already on the next customer's face.
people.subject: The moment: at a shell-coin counter she taps a small white coin against her front teeth, counting, eyes up on the next traveller. Face: a lively, sharp, round face with quick hazel eyes, thin high brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth with a coin at the lips, a hint of greed and honesty at once; about forty. Hair: black with a few grey, in a high bun pinned with a bone comb, a pen stuck through it. Two grey hairs escape the bun at the left temple. Body: sturdy, neat, brisk, forward-leaning at the counter. Clothing: a salt-white sailcloth tunic with a clean white collar, sleeves tied back with duckweed cords, a green cord belt, a small apron. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a pale shell coin with a hole; the left sweeps a pile of shell coins into a wooden till shaped like a tray; a large closed book with a plain cloth cover on the counter. Background: a bright ferry office with a window onto masts, blurred. Light: bright window light from the upper left. A glint of window sun flashes from the coin held to her teeth. Expression: brisk, honest, a little greedy. A faint pale-teal Water hint. Palette: shell white, sailcloth cream, sea green.

people.imagined: On the stranded whale's beach at dawn. A small girl with pale eyes stands at the waterline with a whale's tooth on a cord, looking to the open sea the way the whale came, wanting to know her first words.
people.subject: The moment: standing in shallow surf at dawn, a small girl looks far out to the horizon with her lips parted. Face (most important: the pale eyes and sea-burnt skin): a small, brown, sea-burnt face with a stubborn chin, very pale, almost colourless grey eyes wide and unblinking, a short nose, a mouth slightly open as if about to speak; about eighteen. Hair: dark, salt-stiff, cropped short and uneven, a wisp across her cheek. Body: small, slim, strong, bare-legged, a wild balance. Her arms are thin and brown with the muscles of someone who swam before she could talk, and she stands with her toes gripping the wet sand. Clothing: a clean short tunic of undyed sailcloth, belted with a duckweed cord, sleeves short, trousers wet to the knee; bare feet. The tunic has a plain round neck and is hemmed with a single line of green stitching at the cuffs; the cord belt is knotted twice at the left hip. Hands and objects: a large pale whale's tooth on a cord at her throat, resting on her chest; a small folded grey fan in the right hand. Background: Behind her a long grey rock shaped like a whale lies at the tide line with a pale gull standing on it; a thin line of surf curls at her ankles. Light: soft pink dawn from the upper left. The low sun makes the whale tooth glow like old ivory against her brown throat. Expression: wondering, wild, hungry for an answer. A faint pale blue Water and pale wind hint round her feet. Palette: sea grey-green, pale dawn pink, bone white.

people.imagined: At the ferry's rail, lazily coiling a rope for the six-thousandth crossing. He rubs the ring of rope burn round his wrist and looks past the far shore at the open sea, bored and amiable.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a ferry rail he idly coils a rope, gazing past the far shore with an amiable yawn. Face: a young, easy, handsome-ish face with a wide lazy grin, half-lidded brown eyes, tousled brows, a bit of stubble, a crooked tooth; about twenty. Hair: dark brown, sun-streaked, uncombed, tied with a bit of cord. Body: long, loose, lounging, one foot on the rail. His back is curved against the rail and one foot is hooked behind the other ankle; the sunlit side of his neck is sunburnt red. Clothing: a clean sailcloth tunic worn open at the neck, duckweed-green cord belt, short trousers; barefoot. The tunic sleeves are cut off at the shoulder in a lazy way, and the edges are cleanly hemmed, and a small shell button is sewn at the open collar. Hands and objects: a conspicuous pale ring of scar and rope burn round the right wrist, shown as he coils; a coil of rope in his lap and a small iron anchor at his hip. A spare bit of tarred twine is tied round the left finger as a reminder he never keeps. Background: Behind him a taut square sail of grey sailcloth with a lighter square panel sewn in, a gull sitting on the yard, and low far-off green hills. Light: bright sea light from the upper left. Sun glints on the water in bright coins along the lower edge. Expression: lazy, sociable, a little wistful. A faint blue-green Water hint. Palette: sailcloth cream, sea blue, rope tan.

people.imagined: In the yard beside the third hull, adze in hand. The cut through her eyebrow shows white. She stands very still because someone has leaned on the hull, and she has decided what to do about it.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still beside a hull with an adze lifted, her eyes cold on someone out of frame. Face (most important: a white scar cutting through the left eyebrow): a young, narrow, hard face with a white adze scar splitting her left eyebrow in two, level dark eyes, a straight nose, a set jaw, a thin mouth; about seventeen. Hair: black, in a single short braid pinned up with an iron pin. Body: slim, wiry, forearms thick for a girl, a fixed stance. Her shoulders are square and her forearms scarred with small white nicks from chisels; she keeps her weight on the back foot like someone ready to throw. Clothing: a stiff tarred canvas apron over a clean undyed sailcloth tunic, a duckweed cord belt, sleeves rolled; hard and neat. The tarred apron has three pockets stitched across the chest, each holding a different small tool: a wooden spike, a nail, a stub of charcoal. Hands and objects: a short wooden adze with a curved iron blade raised in the right hand; the left rests flat on a dark hull plank; blackened tar on the fingers. Background: the dark curved ribs of a boat on the slips, blurred. Behind her a stack of long agarwood planks with their ends painted white, a half-open yard door, sawdust drifting in the air. Light: cold grey light from the upper left. Fine pale sawdust hangs in the cold light and catches on her sleeves. Expression: cold, silent, terrible patience. A faint teal Water hint on the blade. Palette: tar black, plank brown, cold grey.

people.imagined: The deck, evening. He counts the passengers with his lips moving and is wrong again, quietly trying a second time, a folded passenger list half out of his sleeve.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a ferry deck, lips moving silently as he counts passengers off-frame, frowning. Face: a young, round, anxious face with wide-set brown eyes, thick worried brows, a small mouth that mouths numbers, a few pimples; about nineteen. Hair: dark brown, neat, parted, tied in a short knot. Body: slight, a little stooped, shoulders narrow. He holds his elbows tight to his ribs and shifts his weight from foot to foot like someone afraid of being in the way. Clothing: a clean sailcloth tunic with a high collar, a grey sash, trousers; neat as a boy trying hard. The tunic is a size too big at the shoulders and the sleeves are folded back twice; the grey sash is tied in a careful double bow that has begun to slip. Hands and objects: the right hand with fingers counting against the left palm; a folded paper of plain notes sticking out of the sleeve; a small ferry token on a cord. The paper in his sleeve has a folded corner and a smudge of thumbprint. Background: Behind him a loose queue of passengers with baskets and a crate of live chickens, blurred; salt-white ropes lead up into a grey sail. Light: The flat grey sky gives no shadow, and his pale face looks washed out, from the upper left. Expression: anxious, humble, doubting. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: sailcloth cream, grey, tan.

people.imagined: Standing on a cane raft in the shoal, a long pole in her hands, singing an old island tongue without knowing the words, bare green-stained feet on wet cane, someone listening behind her.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a bobbing cane raft she poles through shallows, mouth open in song. Face: a cheerful, round, sun-brown face with a gap-toothed grin, wide dark eyes, arched brows, a button nose; about sixteen. Hair: black, in two bunches tied with bits of reed. Body: slim, strong, easy balance. Her legs are bent a little at the knee to ride the sway of the raft, and her pole is held low and loose like a dancer's. Clothing: a short sailcloth tunic, clean, belted with duckweed cord, short trousers; bare feet stained green. The tunic is short and sleeveless with a cord belt dyed pale green; at her neck a thin string of tiny snail shells clicks when she sings. Hands and objects: both hands on a long bamboo pole; bare feet stained green by raft moss, clearly visible on pale cane; a small bone fish-hook charm at the neck. Background: shallow green water, a long raft of bundled cane, a far harbour wall, blurred. The raft is a platform of pale bundled canes tied with red twine; behind it a half-sunken fish trap of woven reed and a heron standing on one leg in the shallows. Light: bright sea light from the upper left, glittering. Light bounces off the water onto the underside of her chin, giving her a gold shimmer. Expression: carefree, singing, innocent. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: cane yellow, moss green, sea blue.

people.imagined: The winter of 519, on Tình Sa beach. A salt trader shipwrecked with eleven strangers is standing in driftwood and wet sand, teaching by gesture, having just found someone she can share fire with.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. On a winter beach among wreckage a salt trader holds her hands out to a shared fire, smiling at someone. Face: a broad, sun-darkened, generous face with strong cheekbones, bright dark eyes, thick brows, a wide laughing mouth with gaps in the teeth, a few grey hairs; about forty-five. Hair: black going grey, tied in a thick knot in a salt-stained blue cloth. A few salt-whitened strands whip across her forehead in the sea wind. Body: sturdy, broad, solid, a trader's frame. Clothing: a thick coat of coarse cream wool with a salt-stained hem, belted with rope, over a plain tunic; clean from the sea. Hands and objects: both hands held to the fire, palms open and wide; at her feet a sack of white salt split open and a piece of driftwood; one small shell on a cord. Background: dark driftwood, a wrecked hull, a grey winter sea, blurred. Light: orange firelight from the lower left, the whole picture aged and softened. The glow of the fire picks out the gaps in her smile and the grains of salt in her coat. Expression: open, generous, warm. A faint blue Water hint in the foam. Palette: faded cream, fire orange, sea grey.

people.imagined: The ferry's first quiet crossing at the age he named the saying. A calm old head sits in the stern, a runaway girl beside him, telling a ship's boy that meeting needs no history.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A calm, forgiving elder sits at a ferry's stern with a hand on the oar, looking gently at someone beside him. Face: a long, lined, kind face with a high forehead, grey-black eyes, soft white brows, a straight nose, a generous mouth in a tiny smile, a thin white beard; about fifty-five. Hair: white and thin, in a small knot with a wooden pin. Body: tall, thin, upright, an unhurried ease. The long neck is lightly bowed and the shoulders are relaxed; his bare feet rest crossed on the boards. Clothing: a plain robe of pale undyed sailcloth with wide sleeves, a green cord belt, clean and soft; a plain cloak across the shoulders. The sleeves are wide enough to hide both hands when folded, and the hem of the robe is lightly wet and darker with sea water. Hands and objects: one hand on a long wooden oar, the other open palm-up on his knee; at the stern a small bronze lamp. On his right wrist is a loop of braided dried duckweed, bright green against the faded cloth. Background: a calm sea and a pale horizon, blurred. Behind the stern a mist-blurred line of low cliffs, a few white birds, and the pale curve of a sail. Light: soft pearly light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: patient, forgiving, tranquil. A faint pale blue Water hint. Palette: faded white, sea green-grey, wood brown.

people.imagined: 1187, on the deck of the second boat, the morning he sails west past the charts, young and sure. He stands at the helm, hair blowing, looking at the horizon where a lost fleet might be, trusting.
people.subject: The moment: memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened. A captain stands at a ship's helm in strong wind, chin high, looking west. Face: a strong, open, sunburnt face with a square jaw, bright brown eyes full of hope, thick dark brows, a broad nose, a confident smile, a short black beard; about forty-five. Hair: black, tied back in a tail, whipped by wind. Body: tall, broad, upright, a born captain. His stance is wide with one knee bent against the roll of the deck, and the coat lifts behind him in the wind like a flag. Clothing: a long dark-amber oilskin coat, open, over a salt-white sailcloth tunic, a duckweed-green cord belt; a leather strap across the chest. On the left lapel of the oilskin is a small brass pin shaped like a ship's wheel; the belt has a short knife in a plain leather sheath. Hands and objects: both hands on a spoked wooden wheel; a brass spyglass tucked in his belt; a plain bone ring on the left hand. The knuckles are white on the wheel; a rope end whips out beside him. Background: a grey-blue sea, white caps, a pale horizon and a taut sail, blurred. Far behind, a second ship with a pale mended sail follows at a distance, and a single cloud lies on the horizon. Light: bright windy light from the upper left, the whole picture aged and softened. Expression: confident, trusting, eager. A faint pale teal Water hint in the spray. Palette: faded amber, sea blue, salt white.

people.imagined: The quay of Lãng Thạch at dusk. She holds the little whistle at her chest between two fingers, never blowing it since the fever, looking at the boats and thinking of the captain she was not aboard with.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a quay at dusk, holding a small whistle against her chest, looking at the ships. Face: a hard, handsome, weathered face with a strong jaw, narrow dark eyes shadowed by grief, thick brows, a full mouth held shut; a patch of pale skin on the cheek from an old fever; about forty. Hair: black, in a tight sailor's braid wrapped round her head. Body: broad-shouldered, hard, a mate's confident stance. Her chin is lifted slightly and her feet are set wide, with the stiff posture of a person who has stood watches for twenty years. Clothing: a clean salt-white sailcloth tunic under a short sea-blue canvas vest, a green cord belt, rolled trousers; sleeves rolled to the elbow. Beneath the vest the sailcloth tunic has a high collar of blue tape; on the vest's left breast is a row of three small bone buttons, one replaced with brass. Hands and objects: a small bone whistle on a bleached white cord, held in her right fingers, clearly visible; her left hand on a coil of rope on the quay. Background: a stone quay with a moored boat and a lantern, dusk sky, blurred. Beyond the quay, two coast-trader hulls ride at anchor with their sails furled, and a single lantern is being lit on the nearer deck. Light: low blue dusk from the left with a warm lantern edge. The water holds the last orange of the sky in a long stripe. Expression: stubborn, grieving, shut. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: sailcloth white, sea blue, bone white.

people.imagined: The Strangers' Hall's long table at dusk. He ladles soup into a stranger's bowl, the old reed cuts white across both forearms, and he is smiling because someone came in out of the cold.
people.subject: The moment: at a long table he ladles soup into a bowl held out to a stranger, smiling kindly. Face: a broad, open, tired, kind face with wide-set warm brown eyes, soft brows, a large nose, a gentle wide mouth, stubble; about forty. Hair: black, thick, tied at the nape with a bit of cloth. Body: big, soft-shouldered, comfortable. He bends slightly at the waist toward the bowl, wide shoulders softened, a posture of someone who has fed many people. Clothing: a clean salt-white sailcloth tunic with a neat apron, sleeves rolled to the elbow, a duckweed cord belt. The apron has two squares of different blue cloth sewn on as pockets, and an old brown shell coin hangs at the neck on a cord. Hands and objects: a long ladle in his right hand over a black iron pot of steaming soup; both forearms covered with thin white healed cuts like marks of reeds, plainly visible; an earthen bowl held out. Background: Behind him the long table holds a dozen wooden bowls, a loaf of coarse bread, a jug of water, and a few weary strangers with bowed heads, blurred. Light: warm hearth light from the lower left. Steam from the pot rises across the beam of light and lights the stubble on his jaw. Expression: generous, gentle, patient. A faint green Wood and teal Water hint in the steam. Palette: warm brown, cream, soup amber.

people.imagined: The night crossing, rowing beside the lazy boy. Wind-chapped lips sealed with wax, she looks at him without sympathy and says the ferry goes everywhere twice a day.
people.subject: The moment: seated at an oar on the ferry at night, she looks sideways at a companion out of frame, deadpan. Face (most important: lips sealed with a shine of wax): a plain, broad, wind-chapped face, wide-set grey eyes, thick straight brows, a short nose, lips shiny with beeswax and cracked at the edges; about nineteen. Hair: dark brown, in a thick single braid wrapped round the head. Body: stocky, strong, upright at the oar. Her back is straight and her shoulders roll with each stroke; her feet are braced against a thwart. Clothing: a clean salt-white sailcloth tunic with a hood, a short oilskin cape, a green cord belt; neat. The oilskin cape is dark amber with a hood thrown back, and the sailcloth tunic beneath has a drawstring neck tied in a flat knot. Hands and objects: both hands on a long wooden oar, knuckles red from cold; a small beeswax block in her pocket edge. A strip of grey cloth is wrapped round the left wrist above the calluses. Background: a dark sea, a stern lantern, a distant light, blurred. The wake behind the oar glows faintly pale, the far shore shows as a low dark line with two pin-points of light, and the sail overhead is a grey shape. Light: a stern lamp from the upper right, warm on one cheek, blue dark elsewhere. A little rain glitters in the lamp beam. Expression: dry, content, patient. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: oilskin amber, night blue, cream.

people.imagined: On the shoal yard, planing a long plank for a hull he does not know the purpose of. Pale curls fall into his hair, and he works without asking.
people.subject: The moment: bending over a workbench in a yard, drawing a plane along a plank, curls falling into his hair. Face: a young, mild, pale face with round dark eyes, soft eyebrows, a small nose, a gentle, close mouth; wood-shaving curls stuck in the hair; about eighteen. Hair: black, thick, full of pale plane curls like a wreath. Body: slender, a little stooped, neat. He stands with his knees slightly bent and his elbows tucked, long arms pushing the plane with an even rhythm. Clothing: a clean sailcloth tunic with a canvas apron, sleeves tied back, a green cord belt; bare feet. The apron is of tarred canvas with a pocket full of pencils and chalk; under it the tunic has a pale seam at the right shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands on a wooden plane shaving a long pale plank, a thin curl rising; a pencil behind the ear; a small mallet at the bench. A string of fine wood shavings curls over his wrist and falls to the ground. Background: Behind him a long wall of pale new planks leaning against each other, a barrel of tar, and a half-built hull showing dark ribs against a grey sky. Light: soft light from the upper left. Dust motes float in the light. Expression: humble, diligent, incurious. A faint green Wood hint. Palette: plank yellow, cream, tar black.

people.imagined: At the till on the coast trader's boat, counting a string of shell buttons around her neck when angry. She has just been told that the whale-child wants the third boat.
people.subject: The moment: at a till, she counts the shell buttons of a necklace between finger and thumb, jaw tight with anger. Face: a young, honest, sharply pretty face with arched dark brows pulled together, flashing black eyes, a straight small nose, a firm mouth turned down; about twenty-two. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a white shell cord. Body: slender, upright, taut. Her spine is rigid and her shoulders are raised a little, with a clenched stillness in the neck. Clothing: a crisp salt-white sailcloth tunic with a blue collar, a green cord belt, sleeves tied; neat. The blue collar of the tunic is stitched with a row of tiny white stitches like waves; the sleeves are tied above the elbow with a green cord. Hands and objects: a necklace of tiny white shell buttons round her neck, the right hand counting them; a small tray of shell coins beside her. The till is a flat wooden tray divided into little compartments, each holding a heap of white shell coins sorted by size. Background: a boat cabin with shelves and a small hanging lamp, blurred. Behind her a plank wall hung with a sailor's oilskin, a coil of rope and a brass lantern swinging gently with the boat's motion. Light: lamp light from the upper left. The swinging lantern moves a slow pool of gold light over her face. Expression: stiff anger, held back. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: shell white, sea blue, lamp gold.

people.imagined: A copy desk in the Strangers' Hall. She chews the end of the pen, ink on her lip, deciding whether a stranger's home deserves a better line.
people.subject: The moment: at a low desk she chews the end of her brush pen, ink on her lip, eyes on a small coin set beside the page. Face (most important: ink on the lip): a plain, clever, narrow face with a long nose, hooded brown eyes, thin brows lifted slightly, an ink-black smudge on the lower lip, a sly little smile; about twenty-four. Hair: black, in two short braids pinned back, a pen stuck behind the ear. Body: slim, bent over the work. She sits with one foot tucked under her and her back bowed forward over the page like a bird over a worm. Clothing: a clean undyed sailcloth tunic with ink-stained cuffs, a green cord belt, a grey apron. The apron is grey with a pocket of spare pens; the tunic has a stain of ink down the front like a dark river. Hands and objects: a brush pen held at the mouth; on the desk a thick plain book with blank-looking pages, a small copper coin by the book's edge; an ink stone. Her right-hand fingertips are black, and a second brush is stuck behind her left ear beside the first. Background: a wooden hall, a window onto the sea, blurred. Behind her a long wall of pigeonholes stuffed with rolled paper, and a window with the sea showing in a thin bright strip. Light: soft window light from the upper left. Light from the window lies in a long white bar across the paper. Expression: sly, patient, tempted. A faint green Wood hint at the ink. Palette: ink black, paper cream, copper.

people.imagined: On the freight raft at noon, resting on the pole. He listens to his sister singing, knowing the words mean something because their grandmother wept at them, and calmly poles on.
people.subject: The moment: leaning on a long pole at the stern of a loaded freight raft, listening with a calm half smile. Face: a calm, wide, brown face with a broad forehead, gentle dark eyes, thick low brows, a wide quiet mouth; about twenty. Hair: black, short, bound with a strip of reed. Body: tall, strong, loose, a patient stance. His feet are set apart on the cane bundles, and his long arms hold the pole across his thighs as he rests. Clothing: a clean sailcloth tunic open at the throat, a green cord belt, short trousers; bare feet. A scrap of red cloth is tied round the upper left arm, and the tunic has a faded blue stripe at the hem like a fisherman's mark. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a bamboo pole with a visible ridge of hard callus across each palm; bundles of freight and sacks on the raft. The freight is a pile of rice sacks tied with duckweed cord and a small basket of live crabs. Background: a calm shallow bay, cane rafts, a far headland, blurred. Behind him, a second raft poled by a small figure, a dark line of reeds, and a pale sky with two thin clouds. Light: bright noon light from the upper left. The noon light makes the water around the raft glitter in a dazzle that outlines his shoulders. Expression: calm, forgiving, loyal. A faint teal Water hint. Palette: cane yellow, sea green, sail cream.
